fixes_applied: 2026-10-24 rescue (worker w047): fresh direct frame reads of unique_slides/slide_047.jpg plus 6x/12x/20x PIL crops replaced the raw analysis' guesses; every listed uncertainty resolved from the frame.
Initial W: the frame shows THREE stacked entries 4 / -2 / -2 (12x crop; the two -2 glyphs are identical). The spec's '[4; -2]' was a truncated read -> corrected to [4; -2; -2].

Class rows: BOTH matrices print C₁ C₁ C₁ (red) then C₂ C₂ C₂ (blue) — three of each (6x crops + per-glyph colour sampling: C₁ core ~ (147,19,42), C₂ ~ (19,1,135)). The spec's 'C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂ C₂' is corrected in labels, visual_elements and brief.

Augmented matrix: the frame shows header + THREE data rows — (1 1 1 1 1 1) / (1 2 1 5 6 6) / (1 1 2 4 5 6); each column is a 3-component column vector in one spanning paren pair. The spec's 4-row version with a duplicated row was a grouping error; corrected.
Z matrix headers resolved: all three read Z₁ verbatim (ASCII bitmap of the header band: three identical Z + vertical-stroke subscript, no 2/3 curvature). NOT Z₂/Z₃ — the uncertainty is closed.

Calc-box subscripts: box 1 reads d(Z₁); boxes 2 and 3 both read d(Z₂) (20x bitmaps; the two subscripts are the same 7-px-wide glyph, distinct from box 1's 5-px '1'). Equations corrected from the spec's all-d(Z₁) to Z₁/Z₂/Z₂.

Equation bracket notation '[1 0 0; -4 0; 14]' was a garbled read: the frame shows a BLUE row vector (1 0 0) times a GREEN stacked column (14; -4; 0). Equations rewritten as (1 0 0)(14; -4; 0) = 14, etc.

Legend has no space between C₂ and 'negative' ('C₂negative', measured); the block title prints 'Ugmented Vectors ( from Top )' with spaces inside the parens -> verbatim strings corrected.
Typography: the frame is SERIF (Times-like) throughout, not sans-serif; headers are lowercase italic x₁..x₆, not uppercase -> corrected.
Colours measured and recorded: cream top band #FFFFE8; dark blue accents ~#1A1A99; red ~#C00000 (flat button interior median (198,0,16)); green (14;-4;0) stack; gray-blue box borders ~#A6ACB8.
